title: Canvas Deep Clean & Mud Extraction
treatmentNotes: Dried mud splatters and dark stains across the canvas upper, grimy laces, and a scuffed, soiled rubber sole. Deep foam cleaning lifted the stains, laces were replaced with fresh white ones, and the rubber foxing and toe cap were brightened back to white.

title: Complete Canvas Fiber Revival & Sole Brightening
treatmentNotes: Deep ground-in dirt, heavy road soil splatters across the canvas weave, brown stained laces, and scuffed foxing revived to factory-clean finish with bright white rubber midsoles.

title: Precision Outsole Delamination Rebonding Surgery
treatmentNotes: Severe outsole separation along the forefoot and toe box with brittle yellowed adhesive residue and scuffed leather. Old glue was chemically stripped, surfaces primed, rebonded with heat-activated polyurethane adhesive under pneumatic pressure, and the upper cleaned.

title: Artisan Hand-Buffed Wax Polish & Scuff Buffing
treatmentNotes: Dry, parched calfskin leather with abrasive toe-cap scratches and dull finish. Treated with deep lanolin conditioner, pigment blending, and hand-buffed carnauba wax mirror shine.

title: Inner Heel Collar & Structural Stitching Re-lining
treatmentNotes: Inner heel collar fabric shredded from friction wear with yellowed foam bursting out. Old damaged lining was trimmed, reinforced with anatomical padding, and re-lined with durable charcoal microfiber velvet and factory double-stitching.

title: Intensive Outsole Grooving & Gravel De-Pebbling
treatmentNotes: Heavily caked dried road mud and deep-seated gravel pebbles firmly lodged in the traction grooves. Stones extracted manually, rubber tread agitated with botanical wash, and factory gum grip restored.

title: Express Sidewall Brightening & Scuff Reduction
treatmentNotes: Daily street scuff streaks along the white rubber foxing and dusty upper. Express surface scrub, edge brightening, fresh white laces, and leather hydration.
